proposed_title: Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
target: core | transversal | TX-A floor (L1 on every role profile)
rationale: Universal data-literacy floor (P-DC-05); the 2025-26 evidence most consistently demands it of non-specialists (ADR-0025).

proposed_title: Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
target: core | transversal | TX-A floor (L1 on every role profile)
rationale: Responsible everyday AI use is a floor, not a specialism (P-DC-05; DOL frames AI literacy for the whole workforce [E: DC-015]); crosswalk to DOL AI Literacy Framework TEN 07-25 (X12).

proposed_title: Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference
rationale: Survivor: absorbs C-LM-01 (plan-level monitoring design) and the design content of v1 2.2.2; monitoring design recurs in every module (G-4).

proposed_title: Engineer environmental sensor-network and streaming data pipelines
rationale: Sensor-network and streaming pipelines recur in water, air, wildlife and hazards modules (G-4); absorbs DC part of v1 2.3.1 and automated QC design from 2.6.4; product names to L4 (T-1).

proposed_title: Document data provenance and lineage for environmental evidence
target: core | practice | TX-A at L1; DC practice above L2
rationale: Provenance and AI-involvement records are the precondition for validation and the administrative record (ADR-0025, SC-C02 link).

proposed_title: Steward and publish environmental data for reuse
rationale: Survivor: absorbs C-LM-04 (authoritative plan datasets) and v1 2.2.5 metadata content; open-data stewardship is cross-sector.

proposed_title: Protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products
rationale: Sensitive ecological, cultural and personal data protection is cross-sector; indicators touching Tribal data are drafted internally only and held under ADR-0007/TN-C03, TN-C07.

proposed_title: Conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code
rationale: Successor of v1 2.2.4 (programming): durable core is reproducibility, testing and review of AI-generated code, language names to L4 (T-1, DC disposition).

proposed_title: Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence
rationale: Model fitness-for-purpose and independent validation; absorbs v1 2.6.5 interpretability content; DC enactment of the validation floor.

proposed_title: Apply Earth-observation foundation models and learned embeddings to environmental mapping
rationale: EO foundation models and embeddings are a method within remote-sensing analysis with a 1-3 year half-life (T-3); merged into rewritten v1 2.1.2 with FM indicators at L4 and model families in L4 (ADR-0003 T-1, T-5).

proposed_title: Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions
rationale: Uncertainty quantification and communication for decisions is needed in every module and by SC roles briefing decision-makers.

proposed_title: Build, run and validate environmental forecast systems and digital twins
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FS-C11 (digital-twin lifecycle stewardship) and v1 2.7.3; forecast and twin work is emerging across water, fire, air and coastal programmes (ADR-0015 emerging, develop-only).

proposed_title: Validate AI-generated environmental analyses before professional use
target: core | transversal | TX-A floor (with FC, DC and SC enactments)
rationale: Survivor of the AI-output validation cluster: absorbs FS-C01, FH-C15 and v1 7.2.1; craft enactments carry ecological plausibility (FC), validation at volume (DC) and legal sufficiency (SC) (ADR-0025 s.2).

proposed_title: Design human-in-the-loop review for AI-assisted environmental workflows
rationale: Human-in-the-loop review design; absorbs v1 2.5.5 workflow design and the oversight-design part of v1 7.1.4 (ADR-0025).

proposed_title: Build task-specific evaluation sets and benchmark AI tools before adoption
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FS-C17 (domain tasks and rubrics for evaluating environmental AI); pre-adoption benchmarking is the gap agencies report (ADR-0025).

proposed_title: Analyze regulatory, planning and public-comment text with LLMs, with traceable citations
target: core | practice | DC specialist responsible-AI (SC enactment)
rationale: LLM text analysis with traceable citations; successor of the AI part of v1 6.4.4; agency tools are supplemental with analyst verification [E: DC-001].

proposed_title: Supervise agentic AI workflows in environmental analysis
target: L5 watch item (hypothesized entity; review +12 months)
rationale: [S] evidence only; enters as a watch item and is promoted to lifecycle proposed when ADR-0015 thresholds are documented (>=3 independent signals of >=2 types from >=2 sector actors).

proposed_title: Curate authoritative knowledge corpora for retrieval-augmented AI
rationale: Successor of v1 2.5.4 (knowledge management systems) rewritten to the durable function of curating authoritative corpora for retrieval; links to TX-D knowledge continuity.

proposed_title: Assess and manage model risk for consequential environmental decisions
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FS-C02 (model risk management) and the risk-tiering part of v1 7.1.4 (ADR-0025).

proposed_title: Specify, evaluate and accept AI and analytics services in procurement
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FS-C10 (technology contracts that protect public data rights); procurement of AI and analytics recurs across sector actors.

proposed_title: Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios
rationale: Enterprise data and AI portfolio governance for senior roles; receives the durable content of v1 3.5.5 (TN-required IK-protection indicator held under TN-C03).

proposed_title: Design decision-support products for actual decision contexts
rationale: Successor of v1 2.4.3 (decision support systems), rewritten to the decision context rather than the DSS software (T-1).

proposed_title: Operate and optimize drinking water treatment processes to meet regulatory and aesthetic targets
rationale: Survivor for drinking-water process operation; absorbs LC-C-05 and SL-C05 (responsible-charge operation); operator certification is a Credential gate (T-8).

proposed_title: Operate and optimize wastewater treatment and resource-recovery processes
rationale: Survivor for wastewater and resource-recovery operation; absorbs LC-C-05 and SL-C05 wastewater content; largest uncovered public workforce in v1 [E: DB-003].

proposed_title: Supervise automated and AI-assisted process control in environmental operations
target: core | practice | WF-OPERATE (operations enactment of TX-A)
rationale: Supervising automated and AI-assisted process control recurs in water, air, energy and waste operations (G-4); operations enactment of v1 7.2.3 trust calibration.

proposed_title: Interpret and apply drinking water compliance requirements
rationale: Same task core as SL-C06 (public water system compliance); SL-C06 is the more complete regulator-side statement, with a utility (regulated-party) variant.

proposed_title: Manage utility assets and capital plans using risk-based asset management
rationale: Risk-based asset management recurs in utilities, parks and facilities, roads and fleets (G-4); receives v1 3.3.2 and 3.3.3.

proposed_title: Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities
rationale: Survivor: absorbs LC-C-06; OT cybersecurity spans water, air monitoring networks and energy facilities.

proposed_title: Write and administer discharge permits
rationale: Discharge permit writing is the water enactment of the core authorization competency SL-C02 (MOD-02 enactment).

proposed_title: Develop TMDLs and watershed-based restoration plans
rationale: TMDLs and watershed plans are subsector-specific (W06).

proposed_title: Inspect, verify and maintain stormwater control measures over their lifecycle
rationale: Stormwater control lifecycle inspection (W03, MS4); sits beside carried v1 4.7.1/4.7.3 (DB and FC verdicts).

proposed_title: Plan water supply and allocation under hydrologic uncertainty
rationale: Water supply and allocation planning is W04-specific.

proposed_title: Characterize groundwater systems and protect drinking water sources
rationale: Groundwater and source-water protection is W05-specific.

proposed_title: Write and review air permits for stationary sources
rationale: Air permit writing is the air (MOD-03) enactment of core authorization SL-C02; Title V/NSR authority knowledge lives in the enactment, not a separate core competency (SC verdict on 6.1.3 coarseness).

proposed_title: Operate and quality-assure ambient air monitoring networks, including sensor data
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FC-C17 (field station audit) and SL-C13 (testing and monitoring programmes); splits monitoring QA out of v1 6.7.5.

proposed_title: Build emissions inventories and air quality models for attainment planning
rationale: Emissions inventories and attainment modelling split out of v1 6.7.5 (DB, SL verdicts).

proposed_title: Plan smoke management that reconciles prescribed fire and air quality rules
rationale: Smoke management sits at the air-fire boundary; home MOD-03 under the home-module rule, enacted in MOD-11 for burn planning.

proposed_title: Manage solid waste collection, processing and disposal systems
rationale: Solid waste systems (P02).

proposed_title: Administer extended producer responsibility and materials-management programs
rationale: Survivor: absorbs PS-C17 (producer-responsibility compliance, the private enactment); state EPR administration is the public enactment.

proposed_title: Determine hazardous waste status and manage generator compliance
rationale: Hazardous waste determination and generator compliance (P03).

proposed_title: Conduct environmental site assessment and site characterization
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FC-C05 (field investigation at contaminated sites); site characterization home is P04.

proposed_title: Select, design and oversee remedies and long-term stewardship
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FH-C12 and SL-C09 (cleanup oversight and remediation funds); receives the remediation-management part of v1 4.4.4.

proposed_title: Investigate and manage emerging contaminants across media
rationale: Emerging contaminants (e.g. PFAS) cross water, waste, air and health modules (G-4); emerging pending >=30 postings/PDs across >=3 actor types.

proposed_title: Evaluate chemical hazards and risks under chemical regulatory programs
rationale: Chemical regulatory risk evaluation (P05); drafted in wave 2.

proposed_title: Certify, inspect and enforce pesticide use
rationale: Pesticide certification, inspection and enforcement (P05); applicator certification is a Credential (T-8).

proposed_title: Conduct multimedia compliance inspections and build enforceable case records
rationale: Multimedia inspection-to-case is covered by the SL-C03 (inspection) and SL-C04 (enforcement case) survivors; DB case-record anchors carried as indicators.

proposed_title: Target and verify compliance with data analytics and remote monitoring
rationale: Data-driven targeting and remote compliance verification is a distinct judgment-bearing product across modules; emerging.

proposed_title: Run a facility environmental management system and compliance calendar
rationale: Survivor: absorbs PS-C10; the regulated-party mirror of inspection and receives the compliance-management half of v1 6.1.2 (SL, PS verdicts).

proposed_title: Conduct risk-based environmental public health inspections
rationale: Same task core as SL-C07 (environmental public health inspection and plan review).

proposed_title: Investigate environmental health complaints, outbreaks and emerging hazards
rationale: Complaint and outbreak investigation merges with LC-C-07 (environmental public health hazard investigation) in MOD-06.

proposed_title: Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty
rationale: Risk communication under uncertainty is required across modules and functions (ADR-0025 TX-E).

proposed_title: Site and permit utility-scale clean energy and storage projects
rationale: Utility-scale clean energy siting and permitting (E01).

proposed_title: Manage environmental compliance for linear infrastructure and rights-of-way
rationale: Linear infrastructure compliance (E02).

proposed_title: Detect, quantify and repair fugitive methane and VOC emissions
rationale: Fugitive methane and VOC LDAR (E03), enacted in MOD-03 air.

proposed_title: Plug orphaned and abandoned wells and restore sites
rationale: Orphaned well plugging and restoration (E03).

proposed_title: Plan and implement mine reclamation and abandoned mine land remediation
rationale: Mine reclamation and AML (E04); public-lands reclamation also enacted via IA-CC-05.

proposed_title: Measure and verify energy and emissions performance of facilities and buildings
rationale: Facility and building energy M&V (E05).

proposed_title: Prepare and verify greenhouse gas inventories for organizations and jurisdictions
rationale: Organizational and jurisdictional GHG inventories merge into PS-C09 (survivor), with a jurisdictional (public) variant.

proposed_title: Develop and track climate action plans with measurable emissions pathways
rationale: Climate action plans with measurable pathways (C01).

proposed_title: Integrate climate risk into infrastructure and capital decisions
rationale: Climate risk in infrastructure and capital decisions merges into rewritten v1 1.5.3 (adaptation planning and climate-risk integration), which recurs across modules (G-4).

proposed_title: Plan and run extreme heat preparedness and response programs
rationale: Extreme heat preparedness programmes (H01/C02) are emerging; home MOD-06.

proposed_title: Develop hazard mitigation plans and fundable mitigation projects
rationale: Hazard mitigation planning and fundable projects (C03).

proposed_title: Conduct environmental and historic preservation review for disaster recovery and mitigation
rationale: EHP review for disaster recovery is the FEMA-funded enactment of environmental review; home MOD-09.

proposed_title: Coordinate environmental response operations within incident command
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FH-C09; operating within ICS is shared by fire, spill, flood and public-health response (DB s.7 Q2 incident tempo) and takes the ICS part of v1 4.3.1; NWCG/NIMS qualifications are Credential gates.

proposed_title: Administer floodplain management regulations and the NFIP locally
rationale: Local floodplain administration and NFIP (C03); CFM is a Credential.

proposed_title: Prepare assurance-ready sustainability disclosures across reporting regimes
rationale: Assurance-ready disclosure across regimes merges into SC-C15 (survivor) with DB anchors.

proposed_title: Manage supply-chain environmental data and due diligence
rationale: Supply-chain environmental data and due diligence (M01).

proposed_title: Assess the integrity of environmental credits and offsets
rationale: Credit and offset integrity assessment merges into PS-C08 (survivor).

proposed_title: Administer compensatory mitigation programs
rationale: Survivor: absorbs PS-C14 (credit lifecycle, private variant) and v1 6.6.2; compensatory mitigation is anchored in the CWA 404/ESA banking market (W06).

proposed_title: Implement coastal zone management and shoreline permitting
rationale: Coastal zone management and shoreline permitting (L04).

proposed_title: Conduct fisheries stock assessment and develop management advice
rationale: Fisheries stock assessment and management advice (L03).

proposed_title: Conduct Section 106 and state historic preservation review and consultation
target: core | practice | WF-REVIEW (X01; Tribal aspects held)
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FH-C08; Section 106 review recurs in every module with federal undertakings (G-4); THPO and Tribal-significance content is held (TN-C11, ADR-0007) and determinations of Tribal significance rest with Tribes.

proposed_title: Integrate environmental commitments into transportation project delivery
rationale: Transportation project delivery commitments (U02).

proposed_title: Conduct cumulative impact analysis for permitting decisions
rationale: Survivor named by function per ADR-0016 ("Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions"); absorbs v1 6.7.2; EJ kept as altLabel; venue applicability computed from instruments.

proposed_title: Generate legally defensible environmental analytical data
rationale: Legally defensible analytical data is the laboratory (X06) competency; field-side custody and QC stay in core FC-C24.

proposed_title: Monitor conservation easements and enforce their terms
rationale: Conservation easement monitoring and enforcement (L09).

proposed_title: Manage grazing permits and allotments
rationale: Grazing permits and allotments merge into IA-CC-01 (survivor, MOD-11).

proposed_title: Conduct interagency consultation on listed species and prepare biological assessments
rationale: ESA consultation and biological assessments recur across forest, water, energy, transport and wildlife modules (G-4); federal-procedure enactment with state-agency variants.

proposed_title: Prepare and administer timber sale, stewardship and partner implementation agreements
rationale: Timber sale, stewardship and partner implementation agreements (L01); links SC-C08 for agreement design.

proposed_title: Develop conservation plans with private landowners and deliver voluntary conservation programs
target: MOD-14 worklands | wave 1 (drafted early for role R19)
rationale: Private-landowner conservation planning (L06); MOD-14 is wave 2 but this competency is drafted in wave 1 because the soil conservationist role profile needs it.

proposed_title: Administer grazing permits and monitor allotment conditions
rationale: Grazing permit administration merges into IA-CC-01 (survivor, MOD-11).

proposed_title: Calibrate remote-sensing and AI-derived resource inventories against field measurements
rationale: Calibration of RS/AI inventories against field measurement merges into FC-C02 (ground-truthing survivor).

proposed_title: Design structured developmental field experiences for entry-level staff
rationale: Developmental field experiences for entry staff merge into rewritten v1 7.2.2 (TX-D formation survivor).

proposed_title: Capture and transfer critical institutional and place-based knowledge before staff separate
rationale: Survivor: absorbs IO-C03, FS-C12, CC-CM-01 and C-LM-05; knowledge capture before separation is the most corroborated 2025-26 workforce need (EPA 30.3-year median service for ~2,000 year-end-2025 departures [E: V1]).

proposed_title: Conduct cultural resource compliance reviews for federal undertakings
rationale: Cultural resource compliance review merges into DB-C50 (Section 106 survivor).

proposed_title: Maintain incident qualifications and serve in incident roles as a collateral duty
rationale: Incident qualifications as collateral duty merge into DB-C42; qualifications themselves are Credential gates (T-8).

proposed_title: Operate fish hatchery and aquatic propagation programs
rationale: Hatchery and aquatic propagation (L03).

proposed_title: Conduct environmental compliance inspections and develop enforcement cases
rationale: Federal inspection and case development merge into SL-C03 and SL-C04 with a federal variant.

proposed_title: Oversee investigation and cleanup of contaminated sites
rationale: Contaminated-site cleanup oversight merges into DB-C20 (survivor, MOD-04).

proposed_title: Write job analyses, crediting plans and assessment benchmarks for technical positions
rationale: Survivor: absorbs IO-C02 (SME in merit-based assessment); job analysis and assessment benchmarks are the instruments that gate mobility (ADR-0023) and are needed by state and federal supervisors.

proposed_title: Justify positions and staffing with workload and mission evidence
rationale: Survivor: absorbs C-LM-06 (labour-market and AI-change evidence in workforce plans); position justification under staffing contraction is cross-actor.

proposed_title: Use AI drafting tools for environmental documents with documented human review
rationale: AI drafting with documented human review is an enactment of the validation floor DC-CAND-13.

proposed_title: Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks
rationale: Field sensor networks: valid data at the point of measurement; receives the field part of v1 2.3.1 and sensor deployment from 1.4.2.

proposed_title: Ground-truth remote, modeled and AI-generated outputs in the field
target: core | practice | WF-MONITOR (FC enactment of TX-A)
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FH-C05 and LC-C-04; ground truth is the FC enactment of the validation floor and recurs in every module.

proposed_title: Adjudicate automated species detections using field-formed identification expertise
rationale: Adjudicating automated detections with field-formed identification expertise; pairs with rewritten v1 1.4.3; formation-dependent (ADR-0005).

proposed_title: Conduct on-site environmental compliance inspections
rationale: On-site compliance inspection merges into SL-C03 (survivor) as its field-performance anchors.

proposed_title: Conduct field investigations at contaminated sites
rationale: Contaminated-site field investigation merges into DB-C19 (survivor, MOD-04); incidental-discovery awareness stays in rewritten v1 4.4.4.

proposed_title: Delineate wetlands and other aquatic resources
rationale: Wetland and aquatic resource delineation (W06); jurisdiction-sensitive (WOTUS still proposed [E: V2]).

proposed_title: Assess stream channel form and function in the field
rationale: Stream geomorphic assessment, the diagnostic missing beside v1 1.2.5/4.2.4 (FC verdict).

proposed_title: Monitor rangeland condition with calibrated field indicators
rationale: Rangeland condition monitoring with calibrated indicators (L05).

proposed_title: Manage vegetation near utility infrastructure
rationale: Survivor: absorbs PS-C12 (utility vegetation and wildfire mitigation programmes); home E02 linear infrastructure.

proposed_title: Detect and rapidly respond to invasive species
rationale: EDRR is the missing early-detection core of invasive species control; merged into rewritten v1 4.2.2 (FC verdict).

proposed_title: Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols
rationale: Field biosecurity and decontamination recur in aquatic, wildlife, forest and restoration work (G-4).

proposed_title: Operate small boats and conduct aquatic, marine and coastal field work safely
rationale: Small-boat aquatic, marine and coastal field work recurs across water, fish, marine and hazards modules.

proposed_title: Conduct cultural resource field survey and monitoring
rationale: Cultural resource field survey and monitoring: identify-and-refer only; determinations of significance rest with Tribes and SHPO/THPO (TN verdict on v1 5.3.3); site-location confidentiality applies.

proposed_title: Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems
target: core | practice | WF-OPERATE (FC primary, DC secondary)
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FS-C06 (BVLOS/autonomous programmes) and v1 2.3.2/4.5.4; T-6: flight near crews is durable practice, aircraft and software are L4; Part 107 is a Credential.

proposed_title: Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely
rationale: Humane capture, handling and marking (L02/L03).

proposed_title: Collect environmental samples for trace, emerging-contaminant and genetic analysis without contamination
rationale: Clean sampling for trace, emerging-contaminant and genetic analysis; receives eDNA field sampling (v1 1.6.2) and field sampling from 1.2.4/4.1.3.

proposed_title: Operate and audit ambient air monitoring stations and sensors
rationale: Air station operation and audit merges into DB-C13 (MOD-03 survivor) as its field anchors.

proposed_title: Navigate and work safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids
rationale: Survivor for field navigation with and without digital aids; receives v1 2.1.3 and the core of 4.4.3 (SAR as optional specialization); SAF requires non-powered orienteering [E: LC].

proposed_title: Prevent and manage heat, smoke and environmental exposure illness in field crews
rationale: Heat, smoke and exposure illness prevention merges into the field-risk-management successor of split v1 4.4.1.

proposed_title: Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices
target: core | practice | WF-MANAGE (field) with TX-D link
rationale: Crew leadership and transfer of field judgment: FC enactment of formation of others; linked to v1 7.2.2 (FC verdict).

proposed_title: Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land
rationale: Working alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land recurs across modules; receives volunteer field leadership from v1 4.7.4.

proposed_title: Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence
rationale: Reading site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence; durable, formation-dependent FC practice.

proposed_title: Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity
rationale: Survivor for field recording with protocol fidelity; absorbs v1 2.3.3, 2.3.4 residual and 4.1.5 (DC and FC verdicts; T-1 app names to L4).

proposed_title: Manage field sample custody and field quality control
rationale: Field sample custody and field QC recur wherever samples feed compliance or science; links MOD-18 DB-C53.

proposed_title: Conduct rapid post-disaster field assessments
rationale: Rapid post-disaster field assessment generalizes the v1 4.3.5 ground-truth pattern (FC verdict); home C03.

proposed_title: Assess tree risk and structural condition
rationale: Tree risk assessment recurs in urban forestry, utilities, parks and forest recreation sites (G-4); ISA TRAQ is a Credential.

proposed_title: Manage risk where people work alongside automated field systems
rationale: Risk management where people work alongside automated field systems merges into the field-risk-management successor of v1 4.4.1, with an automation hazards task set.

proposed_title: Plan and run field campaigns and remote logistics
rationale: Field campaign planning and remote logistics recur across all field modules.

proposed_title: Measure and verify carbon and ecosystem-service field plots
rationale: Carbon and ecosystem-service field plot measurement merges into PS-C06 (dMRV survivor) as its field-calibration anchors.

proposed_title: Implement process-based and low-tech restoration
rationale: Process-based and low-tech restoration merges into rewritten v1 4.2.1 (FC verdict).

proposed_title: Calibrate observers and run field measurement quality assurance
rationale: Survivor: absorbs FS-C08 (assessor calibration and inter-rater reliability); observer calibration is the field side of measurement QA.

proposed_title: Plan, authorize and monitor livestock grazing on shared rangelands
rationale: Survivor for grazing on shared rangelands; absorbs FH-C04, DB-C55 and the grazing part of C-LM-03 (ADR-0018 s.4).

proposed_title: Plan and manage recreation opportunity and visitor use
rationale: Survivor for recreation and visitor use; absorbs C-LM-02 (ADR-0018 s.4).

proposed_title: Assess and design for scenic resources
rationale: Scenic resource assessment and design: one of IA's seven public-lands gap functions.

proposed_title: Plan, maintain and decommission resource road and trail transportation systems
rationale: Resource road and trail transportation systems: public-lands gap function; trail construction itself stays core (v1 4.2.5).

proposed_title: Administer mineral and energy authorizations and reclamation
target: MOD-07a extract | wave 1 drafting via MOD-11 enactment
rationale: Mineral and energy authorizations and reclamation: home MOD-07a (wave 2); the public-lands enactment is drafted in wave 1 within MOD-11 (ADR-0018 s.4).

proposed_title: Conduct lands and realty actions
rationale: Lands and realty merges into core PS-C15 (land rights, rights-of-way and realty), with a public-lands realty enactment in MOD-11 (ADR-0018 s.4 as amended).

proposed_title: Monitor and steward wilderness character
rationale: Wilderness character monitoring and stewardship: public-lands gap function.

proposed_title: Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards
rationale: Survivor: absorbs LC-C-02 (on-the-job mentoring and assessment); certifying others against position standards is a formation-of-others duty at L3+ (ADR-0004 formation attribute).

proposed_title: Serve as a subject-matter expert in merit-based hiring assessments
rationale: SME service in merit-based hiring assessment merges into FH-C13 (job analysis and assessment benchmarks).

proposed_title: Elicit and document tacit expertise from experienced practitioners
rationale: Tacit-expertise elicitation merges into FH-C07 (TX-D knowledge continuity survivor).

proposed_title: Design and run plan-level monitoring programs that answer management questions
rationale: Plan-level monitoring programme design merges into DC-CAND-03 with plan-requirement anchors (P-LM-08).

proposed_title: Manage recreation settings and visitor use to sustain resources and experiences
rationale: Recreation settings and visitor use merges into IA-CC-02 (MOD-15).

proposed_title: Administer resource-use authorizations (grazing, minerals, special uses) and their compliance
rationale: Resource-use authorizations merge into the core authorization survivor SL-C02 (resource-manager variant); grazing and mineral specifics are enacted in IA-CC-01 and IA-CC-05.

proposed_title: Steward and interpret the authoritative datasets and models behind plan requirements
rationale: Stewardship of authoritative plan datasets merges into DC-CAND-06.

proposed_title: Sustain institutional knowledge through workforce attrition and succession
rationale: Institutional knowledge through attrition merges into FH-C07.

proposed_title: Use labor-market and AI-change evidence in workforce and training plans
rationale: Labour-market and AI-change evidence in workforce plans merges into FH-C14.

proposed_title: Design and run performance-based qualification for field and technical work
rationale: Performance-based qualification design merges into rewritten v1 7.2.2 (TX-D formation survivor), with task-book design anchors.

proposed_title: Mentor and assess practitioners on the job to transmit tacit field and institutional knowledge
rationale: On-the-job mentoring and assessment merges into IO-C01 (TX-D).

proposed_title: Identify regionally important plant and tree species using diagnostic features and keys
rationale: Regional plant and tree identification with keys merges into rewritten v1 1.4.3 (species identification), meeting SAF C4-A.1/A.2 requirements [E: LC] (paraphrased, not copied).

proposed_title: Ground-truth and calibrate remote-sensing and AI products with field measurements
rationale: Ground-truthing RS and AI products merges into FC-C02.

proposed_title: Operate and optimize water and wastewater treatment processes using real-time sensor and control-system data
rationale: Sensor-supported water and wastewater process operation merges into the MOD-01 operation survivors.

proposed_title: Apply operational-technology cybersecurity practices to environmental monitoring and utility systems
rationale: OT cybersecurity merges into DB-C06.

proposed_title: Investigate and control environmental public health hazards in food, vectors and zoonotic disease
rationale: Survivor for environmental public health hazard investigation (food, vectors, zoonoses); absorbs DB-C28.

proposed_title: Transfer place-based and institutional knowledge through structured handover
rationale: Structured handover of place-based knowledge merges into FH-C07.

proposed_title: Translate competencies and experience across sector-actor hiring systems
rationale: Translating competencies across sector-actor hiring systems is the practice the mobility theory of change depends on (ADR-0023); emerging.

proposed_title: Work within cross-actor co-delivery agreements
rationale: Cross-actor co-delivery agreements merge into SC-C08 (stewardship agreements survivor).

proposed_title: Manage client relationships and scope for environmental services
rationale: Client and partner scope management with public enactments (G-8).

proposed_title: Develop business and write winning proposals for environmental work
rationale: Business development, proposals and grant applications with public enactments (G-8).

proposed_title: Deliver billable environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality
rationale: Project delivery to budget, schedule and quality with COR, grants and cost-recovery enactments (G-8); receives v1 3.1.1, 3.1.3 and project budgeting from 3.1.2.

proposed_title: Assess regulatory and permitting risk for transactions and investment
rationale: Regulatory and permitting risk for transactions and investment (M02).

proposed_title: Prepare sustainability information for external assurance
